subsystems.name: Syntax and formatting
subsystems.responsibility: Tokenization, recovering ASTs, macro expansion and source formatting.
subsystems.unknown: Grammar and formatter coverage were not audited. Recovering ASTs are admitted differently by editor and compiler paths.

subsystems.name: HIR and lowering
subsystems.responsibility: Workspace data, names and types; syntax-to-HIR lowering.
subsystems.unknown: Shared analysis modules and every lowered syntax form are not audited.

subsystems.name: Inference and semantic checks
subsystems.responsibility: Type/effect checking, semantic pass order and lint findings.
subsystems.unknown: bone-inference disables its own library test harness; semantic fixtures exercise it. Selected purity/reference checks do not cover all language rules.

subsystems.name: Incremental frontend
subsystems.responsibility: Persistent sessions, edit classification, selective rechecking and relocation.
subsystems.unknown: Fresh-build comparisons cover selected edit sequences; not every update path has been reviewed.

subsystems.name: Editor queries
subsystems.responsibility: Definitions, references, hover, completion and editor workspace facade.
subsystems.unknown: In-process results do not establish JSON-RPC transport or client display behavior.

subsystems.name: Instance and artifact graphs
subsystems.responsibility: Concrete reachability, ownership contributions and target-specific artifact views.
subsystems.unknown: Selected fresh-build and work-counter checks are not general incremental correctness or speed evidence.

subsystems.name: MIR and transforms
subsystems.responsibility: Typed control flow, shared representation plans and body transforms.
subsystems.unknown: ABI checks cover selected shapes. Transform interactions and all target-specific options are not exhaustively checked.

subsystems.name: Compiler orchestration and Lua reload
subsystems.responsibility: Admission gates, graph/MIR orchestration, Lua chunk caching and overlay assembly.
subsystems.unknown: Binding rollback is not isolation of initializer mutations, I/O or shader-driver effects. Publication assumes intact runtime helpers.

subsystems.name: Lua code generation
subsystems.responsibility: Render MIR functions and runtime helpers for LuaJIT.
subsystems.unknown: No claim that every generated shape has measured LuaJIT behavior.

subsystems.name: JavaScript code generation
subsystems.responsibility: JS output with a separate cached session and overlay implementation.
subsystems.unknown: Lua reload checks do not verify JS publication semantics; runtime corpus skips must be reported.

subsystems.name: Shader generation
subsystems.responsibility: Shader validation/policy and GLSL pipeline emission.
subsystems.unknown: Compilation tests do not by themselves execute shaders; GL execution belongs to the optional native runner.

subsystems.name: CLI and project host
subsystems.responsibility: Commands, project loading, test runners and host-side reload routing.
subsystems.unknown: Command registration and selected fixtures were surveyed; full process/runtime behavior was not audited here.

subsystems.name: LSP and editor integration
subsystems.responsibility: Protocol server, editor integration and protocol conformance tooling.
subsystems.unknown: The conformance tool is excluded from default Cargo members. In-process query checks do not verify an editor session.

subsystems.name: Wasm and playground
subsystems.responsibility: Compiler JSON ABI in Wasm and browser worker/UI.
subsystems.unknown: Requires the Wasm target and Node. Commands match CI; not run in this survey. Browser presentation/accessibility was not reviewed.

subsystems.name: Standard library
subsystems.responsibility: Rock library modules and embedded/filesystem source loading.
subsystems.unknown: Library tests are shared across language/backend behavior; not a complete per-API contract map.

subsystems.name: Stone and native support
subsystems.responsibility: Engine packages, native ABI, rendering/audio and engine asset staging.
subsystems.unknown: Native requirements differ from default Cargo tests; see README for Xvfb/i3/clang and SDL requirements. This is a boundary inventory, not an engine audit.

subsystems.name: Common support
subsystems.responsibility: Spans, diagnostics, compiler statistics and logging.
subsystems.unknown: Utilities are shared broadly; inline test markers do not show callers covered.

subsystems.name: Cross-cutting language corpus
subsystems.responsibility: Runtime, rejection and protocol examples grouped by topic.
commands: cargo run --quiet --locked --bin rock -- test tests/ --backend js
subsystems.unknown: Topic directories are not feature coverage. JS skips, TODOs and unpinned error cases must be read separately.

subsystems.name: Examples and package demos
subsystems.responsibility: Examples, demonstration programs, benchmark inputs and standalone package cases.
subsystems.unknown: Guide checks cover selected examples; not every demo is automatically executed.

subsystems.name: Repository tooling
subsystems.responsibility: Measurement, packaging and development automation.
subsystems.unknown: Source inventory is static. Performance measurements need comparable workloads/environments.

subsystems.name: Upstream-derived support
subsystems.responsibility: Arena, protocol and test support forks, excluded from project-size totals.
subsystems.unknown: Fork provenance is declared, not an automated generated-code detector.

queue.title: Settle reference lifetime between coroutine construction and first resume
queue.reason: Reproduced explicit-ref/implicit-identity discrepancy; behavior must not silently become the language rule.
queue.conflicts: Inference/reference-policy work must wait for the chosen contract.
queue.acceptance: A stated lifetime rule with accepted and rejected construction/resume cases on Lua and JS.

queue.title: Check JS reload retry semantics against its own runtime
queue.reason: JS has a separate overlay path; the repaired Lua cases provide useful probes, not proof of a JS defect.
queue.conflicts: Independent of frontend and Lua assembly; coordinate shared MIR changes.
queue.acceptance: Run late-failure then retry, successful repeated reload and static removal cases; document parity or reproduce a discrepancy before fixing.

queue.title: Identify the selected null predicate rather than its spelling
queue.reason: The audit reproduced unsound refinement and missed effects for user functions named is_null; resolved declaration identity now gates both exemptions.
queue.conflicts: Completed in this batch; no further inference work assigned.
queue.acceptance: Three invalid same-name cases now reject; the function-value control stays rejected, and builtin refinements plus valid user calls pass on Lua and JS.
